name: If I Say I Love You
source:
In this short visual novel, you play as a guy who struggles to talk to women. He wants to approach a girl at his university – if only he could find his voice.

[From [url=https://wildroseinteractive.itch.io/if-i-say-i-love-you]Itch.io[/url]]
